text: This code is a straightforward and efficient solution to the task. It iterates over each character in the input string `s`, converting it to lowercase to ensure the comparison is case-insensitive. If the character is a vowel (defined as 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', or 'u'), it increments a counter `n`. This process continues until all characters in the string have been checked, at which point the function returns the total count of vowels found. The use of a simple loop and a conditional statement makes the code easy to follow and understand.
